definitions.gloss: 70th birthday; celebration of one's seventieth year
definitions.explanation: A traditional celebration of a person's 70th birthday. The name comes from a line by the poet Du Fu, {人生|じんせい}{七十|しちじゅう}{古来|こらい}{稀|まれ}なり ("a life of seventy years has been rare since ancient times"). Also written {古稀|こき}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{古希|こき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: My father turns seventy this year.

examples.japanese: {古希|こき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We took a family trip to celebrate his seventieth birthday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{古希|こき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}って→祝う：01881_iwau⟧、⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦{一同|いちどう}→一同：08918_ichidou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: All the relatives gathered to celebrate my grandmother's seventieth birthday.

notes:
A celebration of one's 70th birthday, one of the traditional Japanese longevity milestones (⟦{長寿|ちょうじゅ}→長寿：14478_chouju⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧). Also written {古稀|こき}; the traditional celebratory color is purple.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古希|こき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach one's seventieth year
- {古希|こき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧: a 70th-birthday celebration
